Severe Weather Warning for Snowy Mountains
warnings.desc: DAMAGING WINDS averaging 55 to 65 km/h with peak gusts up to 100 km/h are forecast from Monday morning and continue through the afternoon. For alpine areas above 1900 metres, winds may average 80 to 90 km/h with peak gusts of 110 km/h. Winds are expected to ease during Monday evening. Locations which may be affected include Thredbo Top, Perisher Valley and Charlotte Pass.

warnings.title: Severe Weather Warning for North East, West and South Gippsland, East Gippsland
warnings.desc: Strong to DAMAGING WINDS averaging 55 to 65 km/h with gusts up to 100 km/h are forecast to develop across parts of eastern Victoria during Monday morning and continue throughout the afternoon. Some of these gusts may be associated with thunderstorms. Winds are expected to ease below warning thresholds by Monday evening. Locations which may be affected include Falls Creek, Mt Hotham and Mt Buller.

warnings.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Murraylands, Upper South East
warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce damaging winds and large hailstones in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Murray Bridge, Meningie, Karoonda, Tailem Bend and Coonalpyn. Severe thunderstorms are no longer occurring in the Adelaide Metropolitan, Mount Lofty Ranges, Yorke Peninsula, Flinders, Mid North, Riverland and North East Pastoral districts and the warning for these districts is CANCELLED.
